moonbit.note: Upstream publishes no signed checksums; pins are observed values verified in CI before execution. Versioned objects expire (~60 days), so expiry fails loudly and requires a deliberate re-pin.

versions.note: Oracle candidates are pinned inputs, not execution evidence. Missing exact commits/toolchain/OS keep M0 open. CI toolchain bootstrap is not a compatibility pin.

mainListenerProfile.name: main-local-listeners-v1
mainListenerProfile.note: Ordinary non-empty string channels only. Emit is trusted main-local dispatch, not renderer IPC. Symbols, borrowed/mutated emitter methods, custom wrapper mutation and remaining EventEmitter methods are not a compatibility claim.

mainInvokeProfile.name: invoke-handler-tiny-json-v1
mainInvokeProfile.note: The private host controller invokes a bounded MoonBit-owned kernel with captured document authority. No public renderer path. Tiny JSON values only; bounded error messages, not full clone/error compatibility. Invalid handleOnce callbacks reject immediately. Native integration must reconcile invalidated tickets; the differential candidate uses a synthetic trusted-host driver, not a renderer.

rows.scope: CJS resolution and immutable source inventory
rows.gap: Runtime-owned facade declares the app surface; not an Electron compatibility proof or a real packaged app run.

MoonBit lifecycle drives the facade and a real socketpair probe. The unchanged full fixture passes listener registration and reaches readiness, then reports failed/ready-rejected with exitCode 1. No native host or BrowserWindow API in this branch.

Probe verdict NO_PUBLIC_SYNC_PROXY: public cross-world primitives do not establish a secure synchronous function proxy. Synchronous bridge remains unresolved. The full fixture fails during window creation before preload or contextBridge execute.

Bounded main listeners, invoke-handler registration and private invocation kernel are implemented. Handler comparison uses real Electron renderer IPC versus a synthetic trusted-host candidate driver, not native candidate E2E. Production renderer ingress, native sender attestation, ipcRenderer and event replies remain unimplemented.

No native sender-attestation adapter; caller-supplied metadata is not authentication. Registration grants no renderer authority. Core invocation tickets bind completion to the originally authorized document; native invalidation/reconcile wiring is still required.

Executed: resize/DPI observation, DOM-synthesized vs trusted posted-event input, native pasteboard, in-process AX role. NOT_RUN: focus/blur (no key status in session), OS paste, IME composition, VoiceOver traversal, hardware keys, second-display DPI. DOM clipboard probe stalled on the web process. Interactive acceptance still required.
Child probe only; full host/Node/WebView process ledger remains open.
